notes: Translated the Table 2 and Table 3 regressions in Code/analysis.do to R: loaded Data/Clean Data/choice_experiments.dta, dropped non-professional advisors with missing alphavaluefinal (pre-registered), kept Highx10==0 & Highx100==0, and ran OLS with HC3 standard errors (sandwich::vcovHC) on the $covariates2 controls. Table 2 col 2 restricts to professionals==0; col 3 drops professionals through missing stdalpha. Table 3 cols 1/2 split on getyourchoice; col 3 pools with the notgetyourchoice interactions. Single run, no claim-driven changes. The script was written and run in a scratch directory using the task's sandbox command, then copied here. Ran in 1.7 s, no hangs.
